name: BlackHoleIntro
job: A stretchable dark background overlay: hundreds of star trails orbit a centre label; clicking spreads the stars across the whole box. Stars only; the owner places their own content over it
visitor_action: hover or focus the centre to pull the stars into a ring; click, Enter or Space to open; Escape closes
mobile: tap the centre to open; canvas scales to the container and DPR
motion: orbiting star trails with per-star speed, ring contraction on hover, outward expansion on open; reduced motion: static ring
art_direction: Event horizon: near-black ink, cool pale star trails, a single ember accent on the hot inner stars and the CTA, one medium-weight grotesk with tight tracking
